title: Day view: spread event stacks can now claim up to 80% of the width
summary: Spreading a busy overlapping-event stack open used to cap the event column at 68% of the grid's width, which could still leave long titles cramped. It can now grow to 80%, giving spread-out titles noticeably more room to breathe -- the class column still keeps a usable sliver rather than being squeezed to nothing.
